posts.text: No. The issue is the source of the duty. A governor in an "asylum" state can have separate federal and state duties w/r/t an extradition request. State law *can't* change the federal duty (which is why Abbott's excuses are BS), but it *can* change the state duty when no federal duty *overrides.*
